remarks: A one-of-one expression of California Modern architecture, 2231 Foothill Boulevard is a home that simply cannot be replicated. Designed and built in 2007 by architect and owner Ruth Hasell, the residence draws inspiration from the modernist principles of Richard Neutra and Tadao Ando, pairing a deep connection to the landscape with bold, elemental materials. Recognized with an AIA Orange County award and featured by the Los Angeles Times, the home stands as a celebrated example of thoughtful Southern California design.
